title: Birth of BASIC
summary: A Dartmouth-produced documentary on how professors John Kemeny and Tom Kurtz, with a group of undergraduates, invented the BASIC language. It covers the creation of BASIC and the early time-sharing environment at Dartmouth.
why: HN recommends it as the definitive documentary on BASIC's origins, and it resurfaces whenever BASIC or Kurtz comes up.

quote.text: The Birth of BASIC documentary that Dartmouth did for the 50th anniversary is excellent and features him prominently
